notes.title: New Game in Development : Flora Surfing
notes.content:
Flying across the grass atop your trusty log, using vines to propel yourself forward at high speeds, surfing was one of the most popular aspects of Flora. This time around, enjoy a completely new physics system that gives you more precision in your controls and allows you to surf across bridges, on the roof of caves, in just about any dimension that you can imagine.

https://media.giphy.com/media/eK0gD4CGP4xo7TTmBR/giphy.gif

Flora Surfing is a new game that I am working on. If you'd like to keep up to date with development, follow me on twitter @zpetersendev where I will be posting gifs and news as the game progresses.

Flora Surfing will be focused on making surfing as fun as possible, meaning that other parts of Flora (like the minions) will not be returning. This will let me focus on creating some awesome new features for you to enjoy like:

Multiplayer
Moddable levels
New types of terrain
Independent gravitational forces (for example, being able to surf and jump between planets)

notes.title: New update for Flora
notes.content:
Flora 1.2 We added some fun little things into the game. Check it out!

Minion names.
Unit cards for all of your minions.
Sound Menu
Updated controls
Bug fixes

notes.title: Saving and Mouse Sensativity Option Added for Windows
notes.content:
Flora 1.1 Patch Notes

Windows
   * Players can now resume their game after exiting to main menu or closing game.
   * Players can adjust their mouse sensitivity in the pause menu.
   * Red's Dialogue Bubbles now stay on screen for 9 seconds instead of 2 seconds.
